description: Installation of a 20-metre monopole, 12 antennae apertures, equipment cabinets, and removal of the existing 11.7-metre monopole, three apertures, redundant equipment cabinets and development ancillary thereto.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (DCMS Connected Growth: Manual for Places; Pre-application Notification Letter dated 18th July 2019; MBNL - 5G and Future Technology - Delivering the UK's Telecoms Future; DCMS/MHCLG Practice Note for Collaborating for Digital Connectivity dated 7th March 2019; Supplementary Information Document; Cover Letter dated 15th August 2019; received: 20/08/2019. 985266_HSW016_50811_TW0157_M001 Issue A 002 Site Location Plan; 100 Existing Site Plan; 150 Existing Elevation A; 215 Max Configuration Site Plan; and 265 Max Configuration Elevation received: 28/11/2019.  Declaration of conformity with ICNIRP Guidelines dated 08-08-2019 received: 02/12/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The proposed cabinets shall be finished in a dark green colour within one month of installation and shall be maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 5 - Within 28 calendar days of the date of the apparatus hereby approved coming into use, the date of which shall be notified in writing to the Local Planning Authority no less than 14 calendar days prior, the existing apparatus shall be dismantled and removed from the site, including all associated debris.

Condition : 6 - The footway and carriageway adjacent to the application site shall not be blocked at any time during the maintenance of the hereby approved development and all vehicles associated with its maintenance shall only park/stop at permitted locations and within time periods permitted by the existing on-street restrictions.
